product: Magnetic socks that don't get lost in the washing machine. A tiny magnet in each cuff clicks the pair together before it goes in the wash.
audience: US adults 25-55 who do the household laundry: busy parents, young professionals, people tired of mismatched socks.
funnel: Ad -> web quiz (size, preferences) -> personal offer -> checkout. Every CTA must send people to the quiz.
facts: A small magnet in each cuff holds the pair together.
You click the pair together before putting it in the wash; it comes out of the washing machine as a pair.
Subscription: the first delivery is 5 pairs for $29.
After that, a new delivery arrives once a quarter.
Sizes are chosen in the quiz, for adults and kids.
tone: Conversational UGC: a real person talking to camera, light self-irony about laundry chaos, concrete details instead of adjectives. People scroll fast, so every first line must make sense without sound.
